# Radiator replacement and SMOD fix

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Position a container under the radiator drain, then swap mounting brackets on the new unit before installing it. [t501]

## Tools

- [Partial] Container [t501]
- [Partial] Drain plug wrench (implied) [t501]
- [Partial] Angled needle nose pliers or hose clamp pliers [t501]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Perform a full flush of the transmission fluid rather than just draining and filling the pan to prevent recontamination. [t501]
- Squeeze the upper radiator hose while running to assist in burping air from the system. [t501]
